title: Jamaican Cornmeal Fritters
description: Crispy and flavorful Jamaican cornmeal fritters, perfect for a snack or side dish. This recipe combines the classic Caribbean flavors with a crunchy texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, jerk seasoning, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg and buttermilk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat about 2 inches of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the cornmeal mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
